primary_source.author: Aabir Fauzan
primary_source.title: ζ(5) is irrational
primary_source.use: Source proof, parameters, equations, arithmetic bounds, comparison measure, and constants. The new seventh-order derivations are the work of this exploration.
primary_source.audit_scope: Opening construction followed equation by equation; Sections 3-7 audited for transfer; original Appendix A interval certificate used as input rather than independently re-proved; Appendix B equation 5.18 reproduced exactly; Appendix C not needed.

von Staudt-Clausen theorem and Bernoulli denominators

Identification of the proof construction; no Isabelle verification performed
Early equation-transcription cross-check before PDF download

followup_sources.use: Classical level-one Eisenstein lattice sums, Fourier coefficients and odd-weight vanishing; consulted for weight/Eisenstein and zeta(9) parity followups

source_policy: Search-result snippets and unrelated secondary reports were used only for discovery, not as mathematical evidence. The preserved PDF hash matches the MD5 on the Zenodo record. No earlier chat was consulted.
